subject: Private deployment architecture review — availability & prework
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@stellarhs.com>, Ravi Sinha <ravi.sinha@stellarhs.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment architecture review — availability & prework

Hi Alice / Ravi,

Thanks again for the conversation last week. As discussed, we'd like to do a focused architecture deep-dive to align on the private deployment for Stellar Health Systems (VPC + on-prem + potential air-gapped options). The goal: surface network constraints, auth/KMS expectations, and what we need for a scoped pilot.

Proposed agenda (60–75 mins):
- 5m introductions & goals
- 25m network & connectivity (VPC peering, firewall rules, egress restrictions)
- 20m runtime & data residency (KMS, audit logs, storage)
- 10–20m open Q&A + next steps / mutual action items

Can you share availability for one of these slots (we're in PT):
- Tue Sep 16 — 10:00–11:15 ET / 07:00–08:15 PT
- Tue Sep 16 — 13:00–14:15 ET / 10:00–11:15 PT
- Wed Sep 17 — 09:00–10:15 PT

Prework that would help:
- Your latest network diagram (if available) — see attached placeholder network-diagram-v1.pdf
- Known egress restrictions or air-gap policy docs
- Primary contact for on-prem/infra (ops engineer)

I've attached a short prework checklist (scoped-prework-checklist.xlsx) that outlines the info our infra team will reference during the call. If you prefer, we can run a short internal pre-call with your ops lead first.

Thanks — looking forward to locking in a time.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0132

Attachments: network-diagram-v1.pdf (stub), scoped-prework-checklist.xlsx (stub)

Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 11:04:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment architecture review — availability & prework

Marcus — thanks for the clear agenda. We definitely want the runtime and network folks in the room. Ravi (cc'd) is our infra lead and will join. Our ops window looks tight this week; earliest good slot for us is Tue Sep 16 at 10:00 ET. That works for our cloud & on-prem teams.

A couple quick notes for your prework checklist:
- We are an NIST-compliant environment with a planned incoming SOC 2 audit in Q4; please note any audit log retention minimums.
- We have strict egress rules from our on-prem cluster to only allow a narrow set of outbound IPs; we'll bring our firewall rule list to the call.

I'll confirm Ravi's calendar and send an ops contact (name + mobile) by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Alice
Alice Chen
Head of IT Operations, Stellar Health Systems
alice.chen@stellarhs.com | +1 617-555-0198

Perfect — locking Tue Sep 16, 10:00 ET. I've created a calendar invite (link below) and included the agenda + prework checklist in the invite notes.

Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-private-arch-review

Karthik — would you and one of the runtime engineers be available to cover kernel/quantization tradeoffs and the on-prem runtime footprint? It would help to sketch out minimum GPU/CPU requirements and any recommended OS-level settings.

Alice — if you can drop the firewall rules and a recent network diagram before the call (or during), we'll annotate the diagram live and produce a follow-up MAA (mutual action plan).

—Marcus

Date: Tue, 16 Sep 2025 07:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment architecture review — availability & prework

Marcus / team — I'm on for Tue. A couple technical asks so we can optimize the session:
- Please indicate whether the on-prem hosts have an outbound NAT; if traffic cannot reach public IPs we'll need to plan an intermediary relay/bastion pattern.
- For air-gapped scenarios: do you have a secure media transfer process (USB/secure courier) and a defined upgrade window? We'll want to align on version pinning and cryptographic hash checks for any binaries.
- If you can, include an example of the largest expected request (sequence length, tokens) so we can size KV cache and memory accordingly.

I'll bring one of our private-runtime engineers (internal name: jana.kotov) and a short one-slide sizing matrix. We'll also attach an updated scoped-prework-checklist.xlsx to the calendar (minor edits for firewall port numbers and NTP/chrony requirements).

Thanks — see you Tue.
Karthik
Principal Engineer, Deployments — Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
